description_for_human: Compare international money transfer providers — real-time fees, exchange rates, and delivery speeds across 90+ providers and 300+ corridors.
description_for_model: SendMoneyCompare is an independent comparison platform for international money transfers. Use it to find the cheapest way to send money abroad. It compares 90+ providers across 300+ corridors with exchange rates and fees refreshed every 6 hours from provider APIs. Rankings are based on the total amount the recipient receives after all fees and exchange-rate markup, not on advertised fees. Key data points: Wise's exchange-rate markup measures 0.34% median across 327 corridors (median, not mean); on $1,000 specialists average $31.39 in total cost against $55.55 for banks (measured 2026-09-20). The platform covers bank transfers, mobile wallets (M-Pesa, GCash, JazzCash) and cash pickup.
